editorial:
Imagine waking up in a creepy hospital where you are not allowed to leave, and you have powers you do not even understand. That is exactly what you get with these five teens. They are all stuck in a secret facility that feels more like a prison than a clinic. You will spend most of the movie feeling their fear as they try to figure out why they are there and who is really running the place. The vibe is very spooky and dark, almost like a ghost story but with superheroes. It is a slow burn that focuses more on the characters' trauma and friendships than on big city battles.

The acting is actually the best part, as the young cast has great chemistry. While the plot moves a bit slow in the middle, the scary twists keep you guessing. If you like X-Men movies but want something that feels more like a horror flick, you will enjoy this. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the dark details, or just rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick watch.
endingExplained: You find out the doctors were actually using the teens to wake up a scary monster called the Demon Bear. This beast is a physical version of the characters' inner fears. In the final fight, the five mutants team up and use their combined powers to destroy the monster once and for all. After the battle, they finally break free from the facility and escape into the real world together as a found family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves X-Men and scary movies.
